component.name: KJT Invest
component.summary: Private tracker for metals, property, cash and other assets

description.p: KJT Invest (Knowing Jesus Today) keeps track of what you own, privately, on your own device: no accounts, no analytics, no tracking.

ul.li: Precious metals: gold, silver, platinum and palladium coins, bars and rounds, with live prices, fees, and the price history back to the 1960s
Real estate: rent periods and empty months, condo fees, insurance and taxes, co-owners, and the real yearly return
Cash and bank accounts, and other assets such as cars and boats
An overview you can swipe: the total, what you own, the performance over the years and the gains
Optional passcode that encrypts your data, with fingerprint unlock
Everything in one database file you can export and import

description.p: Simpler menus: Overview, Assets (metals, property, cash, other assets) and Markets (metal prices, the price chart and currencies). The app finds its own updates and opens them in Software.
Dark mode: the boxes and lists you choose from are readable again (they were white on white on Linux).

Income and expenses for everything you own (rent, other income, interest; every property cost), month by month. The app updates itself: GNOME Software keeps it up to date from its own channel. The summary box is no taller than its page.

Prices and exchange rates from several sources side by side (the middle value is used); a Currency page with a converter and favourite currencies; four themes (KJT Purple, Navy and Gold, Ledger, Sepia), each light or dark; section headings on every page; a larger icon.

Cashflow for each property, month by month and year by year, in one box you can swipe. Every cost asks whether it is paid every month, every year or once (condo fees count every month, rented or not). Daily metal prices with a one-week view.

Now KJT Invest. Metals show as coins, bars, rounds or jewellery in their own colours; other assets such as cars and boats; the overview box can be swiped for what you own, the performance graph and the gains.
